title.zh: 通过演进式编排实现多智能体协作

inclusion_reason.zh: 强化学习木偶师编排器可作为动态多 Agent 运行时复用，按任务状态控制参与者顺序和终止。
inclusion_reason.en: The reinforcement-learned puppeteer is a reusable multi-agent runtime component that controls participant order and termination from task state.

abstract.zh: Evolving Orchestration 采用“木偶师”式中心编排器，通过强化学习随任务状态动态安排各专长 Agent，而非预先固定协作图。
abstract.en: Evolving Orchestration uses a reinforcement-learned central 'puppeteer' to schedule specialist agents as task state evolves instead of fixing the collaboration graph upfront.

problem.zh: 静态多 Agent 组织在任务复杂度和 Agent 数量增长后无法及时重排，容易产生重复推理、无效通信与计算浪费。
problem.en: Static multi-agent organizations cannot reorganize as task complexity and team size grow, causing redundant reasoning, unnecessary communication, and wasted compute.

approach.zh: 编排器观察当前协作状态，学习下一位 Agent 的选择、顺序和优先级，使组织结构随解题过程演化。
approach.en: The orchestrator observes collaboration state and learns which agent should act next, in what order and priority, allowing organization to evolve during problem solving.

system_design.zh: 系统以中心状态汇总层连接多个角色 Agent，RL 策略控制调用序列和终止，执行反馈再更新后续调度。
system_design.en: A central state aggregator connects role agents, an RL policy controls invocation order and termination, and execution feedback informs subsequent scheduling.

key_results.zh: 动态编排在开放与封闭领域任务上以更低计算成本取得更好表现，收益与更紧凑的循环推理结构共同出现。
key_results.en: Dynamic orchestration improves closed- and open-domain performance at lower compute cost, with gains associated with compact cyclic reasoning structures.

limitations.zh: 中心编排器形成单点瓶颈并需要特定训练分布；摘要未证明在超大团队、异构模型或编排器故障时仍可扩展。
limitations.en: The central orchestrator is a bottleneck trained on particular distributions; scalability to very large heterogeneous teams and orchestrator failures is not established.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
